batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c ST Jayasuriya b SM Pollock

batting.name: DB Das
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b DJ Bravo

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b ST Jayasuriya

batting.name: Mohammad Hafeez
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b ST Jayasuriya

batting.name: AB Agarkar
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b ST Jayasuriya

batting.name: M Kartik
batting.dismissal: c ST Jayasuriya b CRD Fernando

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b AB Agarkar

balls.text: bouncer again outside leg stump, Shukla steps aside and swings, misses, and runs a bye to get his team up to 137
a wide, as Shukla shuffles and gets Fernando attempting a yorker outside off stump, but its goes wrong
bouncer down leg stump, he takes his eyes off it, wafts and misses
bad ball, good shot, Shukla slapping the full toss past midwicket
skips down, Fernando follows him and Kartik just chips it in the air to midwicket, where Jayasuriya runs after it and plucks the catch very well
banged in short, he gets into a tangle with his tennis-ball slap over the bowler, and the ball drops safely in front of long-off
well done, from batsman and bowler! Fernando bowls it into the blockhole but Shukla, again exposing all the stumps, converts it into a four with an excellent slap past the gap at gully
well bowled, young man, just in the blockhole and Shukla, making room, can only chop into the ground in front of the wicketkeeper, then scampers off as Kartik sprints down the track
walks down before the ball is released and steers the full one to third man
and he tries to play it there, walking across the stumps, but the ball is well down leg stump and Shah fumbles, allowing the extra courtesy the overthrow
full again, in the slot, and he can only slash it to deep point for one
sees him exposing all stumps and fires it into the pads, Kartik gets a leg-bye to short fine leg for his efforts
uses his feet and drills the full ball to extra cover, where Pollock dives
slower ball, hit with too much bottom-hand to long-off, but he gets strike
steps to leg and looks to drive, an inside-edge onto the pads gets him a quick single towards backward point, importantly Shukla back on strike
there's a good length and Shukla runs it down to third man for one
awesome hit, thats outta here! Shukla just judged the length and hammered that superbly over deep midwicket ... Fernando cannot bowl that length at this time
fuller length and Kartik plays it to third man for a single to get Shukla on strike
silly, silly fielding! Kartik makes room and slaps a short, wide one over cover-point, it lands safely and dribbles to the sweeper, Kulkarni, who over-runs it and allows four through his palms
thats a good hit! Shulka swivels and carts this one from just outside off stump over long-on's hands, the ball just carries over the boundary ... Kolkata need a few more of those
stands his ground steers this one wide of gully down to third man
change of pace, almost beaten but he pushes uneasily to point
attempted slower delivery loops up and slips down leg stump for a wide
short again, he gets tall and removes a hand off the bat as he taps it away, hesitates for a second but Shukla wants the run, point is slow to react
short of a length on off stump, pushed off the back foot to cover
nips in off a length, Shukla pushes and gets a thick edge to third man
further confusion, as Shukla pushes to point, hesitates, and gets Kartik confused at the other end, luckily for Kolkata the throw was off the mark
flat on off stump, Kartik pushes off the front foot to gully for one
flat on off stump and thats a firm sweep out to deep square leg
another one bites the dust! Agarkar just hits this one down Nehra's throat at deep mid-on and Kolkata are really making a mess of this
there's a wide as Jayasuriya pitches flay down leg stump
comes out, Jayasuriya follows him and he uneasily pokes the ball to gully
flat down leg stump, he uses his feet and clips to midwicket
short on the stumps, again he gets onto the toes and taps it to leg
short one rises on him, he gets airborne and swishes, missing the ball
slower ball, he's not to the pitch but goes over extra cover's head
and he survives with an inside-edge, pushing at the ball and looking on as it sneaks past leg stump to short fine leg
short of a length, he gets up and steers it down to third man for one
free runs, as he strays down the pads and the balls flicked to fine leg
thats a maiden-wicket over, as Agarkar taps the ball back to the bowler
bit of flight, Agarkar stands there and plays to cover, bowler fields
flat on middle and leg and its driven to the man at midwicket
edged and taken! Hafeez sees some room and goes for a square-drive, but only manages a thin outside-edge which Saha gleefully snaps up
well flighted, turns a bit and Hafeez is beaten, well bowled

madness, I say! Hafeez stands and pushes to the off side, starts to run down but then sells Ponting down the river as Rahane swoops in collects, and returns the ball to Jayasuriya, who does the rest .. Ponting harried off down the track and had no chance of getting back ... so his poor IPL run ends with a poor call from Hafeez ... does it remind you of Lara in his ODI career?
comes forward and checks the shot to cover, who runs in and saves
change of pace, bringing him forward to play the ball to backward point
falls over again as he looks to flick past midwicket, but gets squared up and edges to Nehra at third man, who returns a wide throw ... someone shouts at him and he shouts back ... its all happening
good length but a tad wide and it allows Ponting to push off the front foot, but then some superb fielding by Jayasuriya at point saves the run, very quick pick-up and throw
risky single to point, after the ball nips in and Hafeez plays it away, and Ponting wanted the run immediately
well bowled, and well kept, as Saha collects a slower leg cutter after it beats the bat, and whips off the bails ... but Hafeez's back foot was safely inside
and he gets him coming down the track, then fires it in flat and Hussey, looking to go over long-on, can only give birthday boy Nehra a simple catch running in from the ropes
comes forward and plays a drive to extra cover, who is alert
this time Ponting stays in his crease and plays the ball to short fine leg
sees him charging down and fires it in quicker on the leg stump
steps out, gets too close to the pitch of the ball, but runs to third man
fired in onto the stumps, Ponting plays a classy on-drive for one

Slower bouncer, pollock's specialty, Hussey seemingly beaten, came up with his second shot to the ball, late-cutting it almost out of keeper's gloves, and beats a diving short third man, who had just come in for this delivery
Right on the stumps, no room for Hussey, a valuable dot ball
Outside edge, as it just shaped away a bit. single to thirdman
slower ball, Hussey sees it and checks his shot, plays it down to mid-on
Hussey makes room, and slams Pollock over extra cover for a flat four. Wow!
On the stumps, Ponting turns it towards mid-wicket
Hussey steps out, gets to the pitch of the abll, and lofts it over mid-off for a brilliant four
shorter, but this an arm ball, Hussey is lucky to survive trhat as he is beaten and it just misses stumps
full and played back to bowler
looks to open face but plays straight to extra cover
full again, and played down to mikd-on
full, on target, Ponting respects it, and taps it into covers
back of a length, played on the rise to extra cover
big grunt as he lets it go on the stumps and just short of length, no room for Hussey to manoeuvre it
full, Hussey's eyes lighten up, but this is a slower ball that deccieves him, he misses it completely
full, on the stumps, turned to sqaure leg in circle
short, cramps him, he took his eyes off, half moving away, gets enough bat on it to get it to square legg boundary
on the stumps, shaping away, he gets outside half of the bat to point
change of pace, comes in and he plays the ball to cover, who's sharp
back of a length and he cracks off the back foot out to the cover sweeper
good length and he comes onto the front foot, driving to mid-off for one
too straight, he falls forward as he works the ball to midwicket
pushes off the front foot to cover, who is sharp to swoop in and field
slips down leg stump, played off the pads and Pinal Shah stops it
pushes off the front foot, out in front of the pad again, he was trying to on-drive but again played it to mid-off for a quick single
pitches full and swings in, he plays with the movement out in front of the pad and works the ball to the fielder at midwicket
much fuller, he comes onto the front foot and steers to backward point
gets some room but is early into the shot, chopping past gully for one
thats better, a length on the stumps and Ponting presents a full face
easy pickings, as Kulkarni slides down the pads and Ponting helps the ball along its way to fine leg, where Nehra is late to get around .. leg-byes is the call from the umpire
good change of pace, back of a length outside off and he leaves it be
tidy stuff, back of a length and Hussey watchfully defends to point
back of a length outside off stump, and he decides to leave it alone

cracked and well caught! Das gets hold of the short and wide delivery outside off stump but just slaps it into the hands of Uthappa at point, who takes an easy catch to his left and then dofts his cap to the crowd
gets onto the back foot and crunches that to backward point for one
good length outside off stump, Das pushes to cover-point and sets off, cover swoops in and collects and fires in the throw which just misses the stumps, some good backing up saves overthrows
gets a bit of width, but its the slower ball and he chops it to point
good length on off stump, he falls over in his shot back to the bowler
short of a length and he gets over it, tapping to backward point
good shot, just leaning forward and driving in the air over mid-on, one bounce and four, all properly timed and followed through with
swings into off stump and Das punches sweetly to midwicket
on the stumps, no room, and Das drops his head to defend it back
back of a length but down leg and he turns it to fine leg for a single
poor bowling, and Das duly clips the full toss through midwicket
good length on middle and off, he comes forward and defends to leg
full on the stumps and he again wristily slaps that through midwicket
short ball slips down leg stump for a wide, crowd roars its appreciation as umpire Billy Bowden does his thing
fuller on middle and off, slants in and he plays it back to extra cover, but truth be told Ponting wanted to work that on the up past midwicket, he's looking nervous
good ball first up, on off stump and patiently patted down the track
great delivery, hitting a good length and squaring Das up, who just gets bat on it to awkwardly play it down to backward point
shot, son! Flicked off the stumps with utter disdain, that flies over deep midwicket to get the fans chering
superb length outside off stump, lifts and goes past Das' bat
and he pitches on the pads, allowing Ponting a single to square leg
top length from Pollock, again getting Ponting forward to play it back
good length outside off stump, Ponting nervously strides forward and plays the ball to backward point ... he's had a poor tournament
width again but Das chops it into the ground, point fields, so a freebie missed
better ball, fuller and coming into Das, who gets cramped and plays to point
two in two, as Das latches onto the width and slashes upwards past gully and the outfield is so fast that third man cannot get to it in time
top shot, just making room and crunching that past cover and point
fuller length, he plays at it from the crease and survives with an inside-edge past leg stump, Fernando runs around and does well at fine leg
short of a length on the stumps, Ponting moves in his crease and defends
back of a length outside off stump, and he leaves it alone

and he wont get! Pollock hits a length and slants the ball in, McCullum is rooted to his crease as he attempts to nudge it away past square leg, he misses and the umpire upholds the appeal, though the ball, to the naked eye, looked to be slipping down leg stump ... but what an over from Pollock
slower ball on the stumps, tucked to midwicket to open his account

edged and a smashing catch by Jayasuriya at wide slip! Pollock strikes with his third ball, forcing Ganguly to reach out and chase the ball and its weld held at slip, diving to his left and taking it above his head, captain takes out captain!
short outside off stump, he pulls in the air through midwicket to get the crowd jumping around the place ... man, thats some noise!
easy runs, as Pollock goes astray and McCullum, shuffling, tucks the ball down to fine leg for a single, looks to be a nice carry on the ball
all over, and well done Bravo! Chips this one in the air, not timed well but it lands safely over extra cover's head and they scamper back for two to seal the first win of their campaign!
lovely shot, just transferring the weight and pulling from outside off stump smack over midwicket, all off one leg, for a one-bounce four
full on the zone, he makes room and squeezes it out to backward point
short of a length outside off stump, pushed right to the man at point
comes out and slogs across the line but misses all ends up
slower ball, on a good length outside off and he pushes to cover
comes forward and works it to midwicket, who slides and saves runs
bowled full into the leg-stump blockhole but he gets bat on it, flicking down to short fine leg and then responding well to the call for  one
change of pace, bowls a length and Uthappa pushes to cover
tries to whip it away from off stump but survives with an inside-edge, they then proceed to scamper a single to midwicket
slides down leg stump and he clips it out to Ishant on the boundary
full on leg stump, whipped out to the deep and they run very hard for two
pushes off the front foot but gets beaten by the subtle in-cutter
makes room and slashes down to deep third man, who takes the catch, so Bravo cannot be out caught, and its a run to the scoreboard, and the 100th run of the partnership
oversteps, driven straight to cover, so we have a free hit
short and he pulls off one leg, all Caribbean, and Ishant runs around from deep backward square leg to cut off the boundary
dropped but thats a tough call! He tries to steer it away again, gets a thin under-edge but McCullum misses it and that single raises Bravo's fifty
too straight and this time he coolly flicks out to deep midwicket
too much room, too short, and thats flayed through the covers, wow!
a fuller length but he opens the face and cheekily steers to third man, and thats the highest score by a Mumbai Indian in the IPL
shot! Inches forward, then rocks back and flat-bats it down to long-on
slips well down leg stump, Bravo goes for a big flick and misses
fuller on middle and off stump, as he looks for movement, but Bravo uses his feet and goes inside-out into the covers for another single, so he'll keep strike
comes forward and drives all along the ground to deep mid-off
shot, man! Uthappa makes room and drives hard in the air through cover
back of a length on the stumps, he shuffles and drives for one
short outside off and he drives off the back foot, the ball is airborne but goes to Hussey at backward point on the bounce
short outside off stump, pulled with poor timing out to deep midwicket
likes the length and drives off one leg, but straight to the man at cover
change of pace, he gets across and pushes it from middle and off to midwicket a bit uppishly but the fielder is deep so all is well for Bravo and Mumbai
short of a length outside off stump, the effort ball from Dinda, but Uthappa gets over it and glides it down to third man for another single, smartly done
this time he reads it well and opens the face to run it down to third man
beaten going for the exaggerated back-foot drive off one leg, that was bowled a tad slower too by Dinda

slants into leg stump, and he works that excellently out to deep backward square leg, complimenting the shot with some top-class running between the stumps, a good throw hits its mark but ricochets away
flicked from off stump, in the air, out to deep midwicket for a single
good length on off stump, Uthappa eases forward and drives to long-off
tidy stuff, after Uthappa punches back but Dada sticks out a hand to save
quicker one nips in but he works it off the pads to square leg
and again, Bravo gets the back leg up and just drives dead straight past the bowler and mid-off for another flowing shot, not afraid to go over the top at all
pushes down the ground past the stumps, Bravo drops his bat and so they cannot come back for the second run as long-off fields
ah, the class! Bravo gets forward and flicks so, so powerfully past midwicket, who hadn't a moment to react, he is playing so elegantly this evening
arm ball this time, well spotted and he plays it to midwicket
hello, dolly! Bravo uses his feet and plays a terrific Caribbean loft, all timing and elegance, over long-off for half a dozen, beautiful to watch
again some good drift and loop, and its played back to Kartik
woof! Thats crunched off the back foot with some power, and Ishant's sprawling dive out on the deep cover boundary goes in vain
tossed up invitingly on middle and off and he drives that back in the air to Kartik's right side but he fails to get across in time
hits a good length and Uthappa drives from middle and off to midwicket
hits a length and this time Bravo punches along the ground, getting back
straighter one, he shuffles and works the ball to square leg
risky business this, Bravo not attempting to keep the ball down, driving this one too in the air but its well in front of long-off
now Uthappa comes forward and square-drives towards point
driven uppishly from the crease but its into the gap at cover safely

another one tossed up down leg stump, another attempted sweep, another miss, another loud appeal, and another shake of the head from Bowden ... Kartik is pitching a tad too far down leg stump to get a dismissal, but tight stuff nevertheless
fired down leg stump, Uthappa falls over as he tries to sweep, wide called
bit of air this time, landing on leg stump, and its worked to midwicket
another one slides down leg stump, raps the bad, but is turned down
too short and thats a brute of a cut shot, transferring his weight, to beat the cover fielder out in the deep
fuller in length but the huge stride forward negates the loud appeal from McCullum, and the ball was slipping down as well
tossed up on middle and leg, he shuffles and turns it to square leg
fired in flat on middle and off, Uthappa plays a walking drive to extra cover but Bravo sends him back as the fielder moves in quickly
again he walks across and makes all stumps visible before playing a brilliant paddle past the man at short fine leg to send the quicker ball on its way
steps right across, exposing middle and leg, but the ball is fired down very wide and beats McCullum as well ... Kolkata dont need that at all
this one lands on off and turns away, he pushes off the front foot to gully, where Ganguly throws himself around at short third man and saves a certain boundary
flat on middle and leg, Uthappa uses his feet and drives to midwicket
repeats the shot but its flatter and he cant beat the man this time
flat on middle and leg and he clips that over mid-on excellently, all flair
flat on middle and leg, he gets down and sweeps out to the deep for one
pitches on leg, Uthappa waits for turn and works it past square leg
well bowled, pitching on leg and sliding down to catch Bravo on the front foot, they all go up in appeal but Bowden shakes his head, Uthappa calls for the leg-bye
there's the arm ball, sliding down leg to get Bravo in a total mess as he steps back
tosses it up, gets some drift, he waits and steers it to backward point
tossed up on middle, spins away as he gets back and works it to the deep
short one jags in, Bravo shapes to pull of one leg but gets undone by the bounce, the ball strikes him on the thigh and evades a diving McCullum
back of a length, he gets right in line and drives to midwicket
short of a length, he gets up and drives off the back foot but cant beat cover
a slightly fuller length and he drives it past point for a single
and he's dropped! Uthappa slaps a short one in the air to backward point, where takes it to his left but Das allows it to slip out ... that was hit ferociously but he couldn't handle the pace
back of a length on the stumps, he gets forward and pats it back well
short of a length on off stump and he shuffles to play it back to Ishant
now thats a shot and a half! Bravo! Just gets up on one leg and plays the sweetest of back-foot punches, making sure to get on top of the bounce, past cover and point ... really Caribbean that
short again, Bravo hops across and plays it down in front of point
some room on offer and he opens the face to run it down to third man
back of a length, nips into Uthappa, who taps it to midwicket
thats a lovely front-foot push, Uthappa leaning forward and caressing that through cover and point for four, wasn't a bad ball but played on the up very well
gets him shuffling across, then the ball stops on Bravo, who does well to play it wide of Dinda towards midwicket
short of a length outside off and he again covers off to leave it alone
slower ball, too wide of the stumps and Bravo leaves it alone
short of a length outside off, he gets across and defends to point
off the mark streakily, squared up and edging past gully for four, some late movement almost had him beaten but the soft hands worked in his favor
bowled em! Dinda gets Pandey for a duck, slipping in a short one and he rises to try and play it down from the ribs but succeeds in only chopping the ball back onto middle stump
good pace again, outside off, and he defends coming forward
good length on off stump and he comes forward to defend it back

and it works! And what pace! Ishant pitches on a length, moves it in, and Jayasuriya gets an inside-edge onto the top of off stump, which goes cartwheeling very far back to get Eden Gardens erupting in joy!
pacy, sharp delivery gets Jayasuriya ducking but he leaves his bat hanging out and the ball kisses the outer edge and flies over McCullum's head
but thats got bat on it! Ishant overpitches fractionally and Jayasuriya carves him over extra cover with plenty of punch
again he misses out on a leaden-footed cut, slashing and getting beaten, the extra bounce from Ishant just has him in a spot of bother
back of a length on the stumps, worked to the right of Agarkar, who fields
a freebie, as Agarkar pitches miles away from Pandey's attempt to cut
on the stumps and Pandey just pushes it back to Agarkar
and he strikes! Thats a nothing shot, just a chip into midwicket's hands, as Rahane looked to go over the top but went tamely with his flick
back of a length just outside off stump and he pushes it to point
lovely seam position, landing on a length and gently moving it away from Rahane, pushing at it off the front foot, there is movement available
there to be driven, and he does so well, but cant beat backward point
goes thrashing again but misses the ball completely, McCullum collects and the slips are being kept interested
beaten again, similar delivery sucks him forward and then beats him off the upright seam, Jayasuriya poking at it with minimal footwork, top bowling this
good response, landing it on a length and getting it to move off the seam and bounce to cut Jayasuriya almost in half
this time he chases it and connects superbly, flashing a flat six over gully, all bottom hand on that shot, a very wide ball from Ishant
goes chasing one slanting away from him and misses out, had he connected that was gone over extra cover for four, or six
full on the stumps and he jabs that away past mid-on for four, bang!
good length outside off stump and he leaves off the front foot
too full on the pads and its clipped past square leg for four, top shot
full outside off stump, good movement and carry after Rahane leaves
plays from his crease, feeling for it, and chops just outside off stump
another wide, this time miles outside off stump, Rahane needed a ten foot pole to reach that one ... Agarkar spraying it around so far
fuller outside off stump, hint of swing, Rahane leaves it alone
poor stuff, well down leg stump, batsman cant get there so its wide
attempted yorker, slower ball down leg, played back to Agarkar
